cases.explanation: x = 0 is a block split plane, so the step's top face (z = 32, x from -64 to 0.05) crosses it. BuildFaceTree_r classifies the face as crossing when its points lie more than ON_EPSILON (0.1) on both sides, then clips it with CLIP_EPSILON*2 (0.2): a part between 0.1 and 0.2 wide is classified crossing yet clips to nothing, so the whole face goes to the back. The front subtree then has no plane at z = 32, one leaf straddles the step's strip x in [0, 0.05] and the air above it, the step's fragment makes that leaf opaque, and the room air above the strip is filled. At 0.148 this happens; at 0.25 the clip keeps a front part, at 0.05 the face is not crossing, and both controls stay correct on every build.

probes.why: room air beside the player start
air 64 above the strip of the step past x = 0
air 8 above the strip of the step past x = 0
air 2 units past the end of the step
